name: TP53 interactome to pathways
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id:'P04637'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(q:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN DISTINCT q.uniprot_id, pw.name LIMIT 50

name: Potent compound bioactivities on ChEMBL targets
cypher: MATCH (c:Compound)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]->(a:Activity)-[:ON_TARGET]->(ct:ChemblTarget) WHERE a.pchembl_value >= 7.0 RETURN c.chembl_id, ct.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value ORDER BY a.pchembl_value DESC LIMIT 50

name: Pathogenic BRCA1 variants and diseases
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:IN_GENE]->(g:Gene {symbol:'BRCA1'}) MATCH (v)-[:HAS_SIGNIFICANCE]->(:ClinicalSignificance {name:'Pathogenic'}) MATCH (v)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d:Disease) RETURN v.rs_id, d.name LIMIT 50

name: Pathway proteins and GO annotations
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(go:GOTerm) RETURN p.uniprot_id, pw.name, go.go_id, go.name LIMIT 50

name: ChEMBL compound vs OpenTargets drug targets
cypher: MATCH (c:Compound {chembl_id:'CHEMBL25'}) MATCH (dr:Drug {chembl_id:'CHEMBL25'})-[:TARGETS]->(t:Target) RETURN c.name, t.symbol, t.ensembl_id LIMIT 50

name: Bioactive ChEMBL target GO annotations
cypher: MATCH (c:Compound)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]->(:Activity)-[:ON_TARGET]->(ct:ChemblTarget) WITH DISTINCT ct LIMIT 20 MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(go:GOTerm) WHERE p.uniprot_id = ct.uniprot_accession RETURN DISTINCT ct.pref_name, go.go_id LIMIT 50

name: Pathogenic variant genes to target-disease evidence
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:HAS_SIGNIFICANCE]->(:ClinicalSignificance {name:'Pathogenic'}) MATCH (v)-[:IN_GENE]->(g:Gene) MATCH (t:Target)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d:Disease) WHERE t.symbol = g.symbol RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol, d.name LIMIT 50

name: Variant and target evidence converging on merged diseases
cypher: MATCH (t:Target {symbol:'BRCA1'})-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d:Disease)<-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]-(v:Variant) RETURN DISTINCT v.rs_id, d.name, t.symbol LIMIT 50

name: Druggable EGFR variant genes
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:IN_GENE]->(g:Gene {symbol:'EGFR'}) MATCH (dr:Drug)-[:TARGETS]->(t:Target) WHERE t.symbol = g.symbol RETURN DISTINCT v.rs_id, dr.name LIMIT 50

name: Compounds per target top-N
cypher: MATCH (c:Compound)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]->(:Activity)-[:ON_TARGET]->(ct:ChemblTarget) RETURN ct.pref_name, count(DISTINCT c) AS compounds ORDER BY compounds DESC LIMIT 20

name: Variants per gene by clinical significance
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:IN_GENE]->(g:Gene) MATCH (v)-[:HAS_SIGNIFICANCE]->(s:ClinicalSignificance) RETURN g.symbol, s.name, count(v) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25

name: Most-connected proteins by interaction degree
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(q:Protein) RETURN p.uniprot_id, count(q) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT 25

name: Top pathways by protein count
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 25

name: DNA-repair GO term ancestry
cypher: MATCH path = (go:GOTerm {go_id:'GO:0006281'})-[:IS_A*1..6]->(anc:GOTerm) RETURN DISTINCT anc.go_id, anc.name LIMIT 50

name: Shortest interaction path BRCA1 to TP53
cypher: MATCH p = shortestPath((a:Protein {name:'BRCA1'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH*1..8]-(b:Protein {name:'TP53'})) RETURN length(p) AS hops

name: BRCA1 variant significance breakdown
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:IN_GENE]->(:Gene {symbol:'BRCA1'}) MATCH (v)-[:HAS_SIGNIFICANCE]->(s:ClinicalSignificance) RETURN s.name, count(v) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

name: Targets with most disease associations
cypher: MATCH (t:Target)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d:Disease) RETURN t.symbol, count(DISTINCT d) AS diseases ORDER BY diseases DESC LIMIT 20

name: Top biological-process GO terms by protein count
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(go:GOTerm) WHERE go.namespace = 'biological_process' RETURN go.name, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 25
